title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-31
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard recording with a bit of guitar mix‑issues, but an electrifying NYE ’82 show highlighted by Etta James, Tower of Power and a smoking Space→NFA jam.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is generally crisp and clear, though several listeners note that Jerry’s fire‑brand lead tone gets buried in the mix and there are occasional treble‑heavy moments or drop‑outs. Musically the concert shines – the first set bursts out with “Cold Rain,” the Space → NFA sequence is a high point, and the third set with Etta James and Tower of Power provides a must‑hear blues‑rock climax despite some horn‑overpowering moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating from 19 reviews is ~4.37; most comments praise the performance while noting consistent recording mix issues, yielding a strong but not perfect overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clean overall with a bit too much treble; occasional drop‑outs reported in the first set; Jerry Garcia's guitar is often lost in the mix, especially during the NFA jam.

standout_songs: Third set with Etta James (Hard to Handle, etc.)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening, an energetic first and second set that fizzles a bit after NFA, then a spectacular third set boosted by guest horns; occasional horn over‑power can drown the band.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is on fire but his guitar gets buried in the mix; fluid solo during Space → NFA noted but not prominent.
band_member_comments.Keys: Nicky Hopkins sat in on piano for part of the show; John Cipollina’s psychedelic whammy‑bar effects are mentioned.
